items.label: Regulatory status
items.note: 0 = Not FDA-regulated · Mid = IND/IDE exempt determination required · Max = Active IND/IDE held by St. Jude

items.label: Sponsor type
items.note: 0 = Investigator-initiated, internal · Mid = NIH/federal · Max = Industry, or federal with external coordinating center

items.label: Site role
items.note: 0 = Single-site · Mid = Participating site, multi-site · Max = Coordinating center for multi-site

items.label: Oversight bodies
items.note: 0 = IRB only · Mid = + DSMB or independent monitor · Max = + external audit/inspection readiness obligations

items.label: IRB model
items.note: 0 = Local IRB only · Mid = sIRB relying · Max = sIRB reviewing for external sites

items.label: Pediatric enrollment with assent tiers
items.note: 0 = adults only; 3 = multiple assent age bands with reconsent at transition

items.label: Vulnerable/protected populations
items.note: decisionally impaired, wards, pregnant participants

items.label: Re-consent burden
items.note: anticipated amendments requiring re-consent of active cohort

items.label: Language/literacy accommodation
items.note: translated materials, interpreter-dependent visits

items.label: Procedure intensity
items.note: 0 = none/records only; 5 = apheresis, conditioning/HSCT, sedated imaging

items.label: Timed/PK or serial sampling
items.note: any window <30 min counts as max

items.label: Visit window rigidity
items.note: ±14 d vs ±2 d

items.label: Off-site, home, or remote assessment
items.note: includes wearables and home phlebotomy logistics

items.label: IP handling & accountability
items.note: 0 = no IP; 4 = cell/gene product with chain-of-custody

items.label: Blinding & randomization
items.note: 0 = open-label/none; 3 = double-blind with unblinding procedures

items.label: Pharmacy/manufacturing interface
items.note: 0 = none; 3 = on-site manufacturing or apheresis-to-product workflow

items.label: Dose modification complexity
items.note: rules requiring per-visit adjudication

items.label: eCRF volume
items.note: fields per participant-visit

items.label: Number of distinct data systems
items.note: sponsor EDC + REDCap + registry + imaging portal each count

items.label: Biospecimen processing/shipping
items.note: 0 = none; 3 = time-critical processing with international shipment

items.label: Linked or derived data (geospatial, EHR extract, genomic)
items.note: includes SDOH/neighborhood-level linkage

items.label: Expedited reporting obligations
items.note: multi-recipient (FDA, sponsor, sIRB, DSMB) = max

items.label: Long-term follow-up horizon
items.note: 0 = ≤2 yr; 2 = ≥5 yr (gene therapy LTFU obligations)

items.label: Interview/focus group data collection
items.note: count × duration; includes scheduling burden

items.label: Transcription, coding & analysis load
items.note: multi-coder with reliability requirements = max

items.label: Community advisory board or partner site coordination
Dissemination obligations beyond manuscript
items.note: community reports, policy briefs, stakeholder convenings

domains.title: Domain 8 — Data Volume, Abstraction & Registry Burden

items.label: Chart/EHR abstraction burden
items.note: 0 = none; 4 = comprehensive structured abstraction of the full record at every encounter (concurrent or retrospective)

items.label: Diary/PRO review frequency
items.note: 0 = none or ≤1/yr; 3 = continuous/near-real-time patient diary requiring ongoing physician review. Distinct from Domain 5's ePRO item, which scores administering the instrument, not reviewing entries.

items.label: External registry/consortium/DCC submission cadence
items.note: 0 = none; 3 = recurring structured submission to an external data-coordinating center on a fixed cadence

items.label: Linked sub-studies / optional data modules
items.note: 0 = none; 3 = ≥4 layered sub-studies, each with its own specimen/data cadence

items.label: Open-ended/lifetime data-collection horizon
items.note: 0 = fixed end date <2 yr out; 3 = open-ended/lifetime cohort with no defined data-collection end date. Distinct from Domain 6's LTFU item, which scores safety follow-up duration, not data-submission duration.
